Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap from our side:

- Week 1: 9:00–10:00 PT / 12:00–13:00 ET / 18:00–19:00 CET
- Week 2: 16:00–17:00 PT / 19:00–20:00 ET / 01:00–02:00 CET (next day) — alternative for APAC attendees

Option B — Fixed bi-weekly alternating blocks (less churn):
- Session A: 8:00–9:00 PT / 11:00–12:00 ET / 17:00–18:00 CET (friendly for EU mornings)
- Session B: 22:00–23:00 PT / 01:00–02:00 ET / 07:00–08:00 CET (better for APAC)

If you can share the primary time zone for the core engineering attendees (Anna, Liam?), I can tailor the slots. Also please confirm:
- Who needs to be on the technical deep dive (titles/teams)?
- Any specific topics to prioritize (e.g., private deployment, VPC networking, KMS/HSM integration)?

I attached a short pre-demo checklist to help us run a crisp session — can you confirm the attendee list and preferred rotation option by EOD Tuesday? Once we agree, I will send calendar invites and a shared doc for runbook/POC notes.
